text: PR #129 (job 20261010-154004-60r4) fails CI's 'the full history' check: its new rule marks a bound-only cost score provisional, and 'athena check --history' finds 8 older score files (e.g. records/jobs/2026-10/20261013-141005-hrdp/score.json) that predate the rule. Only fix that: version the scoring rules so older scores verify under the rules they were written with, without editing any record. Gating future rule changes on history is a separate request.
